text.title: Subagent As Context Firewall Decision Tree
text.summary: Picks the firewall shape from three observables: how heavy the reading is, whether any input is attacker-controlled, and whether the work splits into independent branches. Every conclusion references a rule id from 01-core-rules.xml.

decision-tree.root-question: Does producing the answer require more than two tool calls or file reads, a location not known in advance, or reading a document from an untrusted source?

conclusion.verdict: one or two direct reads cost less than a subagent round-trip; read in the parent.

branch.question: Is any input attacker-controlled (fetched web page, user upload, inbound email, third-party document, external tool result)?

conclusion.verdict: sandbox subagent: no tools beyond reading the input, fixed extraction schema, source named as untrusted; raw text never reaches the parent.

branch.question: Does the work split into independent branches that do not need each other's findings?

conclusion.verdict: parallel firewalled fan-out via asyncio.gather; each subagent gets its own window and returns its own contract; parent gathers contracts only.

branch.question: Is a closed Pydantic / JSON-Schema contract with summary, refs, confidence, next_actions defined and enforced with max_tokens?

conclusion.verdict: single subagent with the slim contract; parent consumes the contract and pulls refs on demand.
define the contract first; a free-form subagent is not a firewall.
